examples.text_en: She will defrost the food before the night.
examples.text_zh: 她会在天黑前把食物解冻。

examples.text_en: The deft girl can do this work well.
examples.text_zh: 这个灵巧的女孩能把这项工作做得很好。

examples.text_en: He was deft with the ball and the card.
examples.text_zh: 他玩球和纸牌都很灵巧。

examples.text_en: The defunct company left the whole town poor.
examples.text_zh: 这家倒闭的公司使整个镇子都变得贫穷。

examples.text_en: This defunct system can not help us now.
examples.text_zh: 这个已不能用的系统现在帮不了我们。

examples.text_en: They defy the law and the public will.
examples.text_zh: 他们藐视法律和公众的意愿。

examples.text_en: He will defy his father and leave home.
examples.text_zh: 他会违抗父亲，离开家。

examples.text_en: The degenerate man lost all his good name.
examples.text_zh: 这个堕落的男人失去了他所有的好名声。

examples.text_en: They live a degenerate life in that house.
examples.text_zh: 他们在那所房子里过着堕落的生活。

examples.text_en: The degradation of the land was a big problem.
examples.text_zh: 土地的退化是个大问题。

examples.text_en: They talk about the degradation of the system.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈论这个系统的退化。

examples.text_en: Such words can degrade a good public man.
examples.text_zh: 这样的话会贬低一位善良的公众人物。

examples.text_en: The old system will degrade over a long time.
examples.text_zh: 这个旧系统会随着时间而退化。

examples.text_en: A long game can dehydrate a young child.
examples.text_zh: 长时间的比赛会让小孩子脱水。

examples.text_en: They dehydrate the food to keep it safe.
examples.text_zh: 他们把食物脱水以便保存。

examples.text_en: The dehydration of the food can take time.
examples.text_zh: 食物的脱水需要时间。

examples.text_en: No water for a day can cause dehydration.
examples.text_zh: 一天不喝水会导致脱水。

examples.text_en: Some people deify the man in the film.
examples.text_zh: 有些人把电影里的那个人奉若神明。

examples.text_en: They deify their chief and call him great.
examples.text_zh: 他们把首领奉若神明，称他伟大。

examples.text_en: He will not deign to answer such a question.
examples.text_zh: 他不屑于回答这样的问题。

examples.text_en: She did not deign to look at the poor man.
examples.text_zh: 她不屑于看那个穷人一眼。

examples.text_en: He was dejected after the loss of the game.
examples.text_zh: 比赛失利后他很沮丧。

examples.text_en: The dejected boy was home in the dark.
examples.text_zh: 这个沮丧的男孩在黑暗中回到了家。
